summary: Iteration 46: Tested TWO new features - (1) AI Generate Lesson for teachers and (2) Staff Review showing ALL staff. All 11 backend tests PASSED. Frontend UI verified: AI Generate Lesson card visible in Create Lesson flow with form fields (Subject, Year Group, Topic, Additional Instructions), Staff Review shows 27 staff with role badges and filter dropdown, non-Teacher staff (CEO, Finance, etc.) can be reviewed. Fixed React hooks error in MonitoringModule.jsx (useState called conditionally).
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/lessons-v2/ai-generate-lesson returns 400 when topic is missing
Backend: POST /api/lessons-v2/ai-generate-lesson returns 400 when topic is empty
Backend: POST /api/lessons-v2/ai-generate-lesson successfully generates lesson with title, objectives, description, rich_content
Backend: GET /api/admin/staff returns ALL 27 staff (not just Teachers)
Backend: All staff have role field for badge display
Backend: Staff list includes Finance roles
Backend: Non-Teacher staff (CEO, Finance) can be reviewed via teacher-full-review endpoint
Frontend: Teacher sees 'AI Generate Lesson' card (violet with sparkles) in Create Lesson flow
Frontend: AI Generate form has Subject, Year Group, Topic, Additional Instructions fields
Frontend: AI Generate form has 'Generate Lesson Plan' button
Frontend: Staff Review tab shows 27 staff tiles (ALL staff, not just Teachers)
Frontend: Role badges visible on staff tiles (CEO, Principal, HeadTeacher, Admin, FinanceOfficer, etc.)
Frontend: Role filter dropdown works - filtering by CEO shows 1 staff
Frontend: Clicking non-Teacher staff tile loads full review data
Frontend: AI Assistant panel in lesson editor works (Improve All, TCIS Standard, Expand Weak, etc.)
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed React hooks error: useState for staffFilter was called after conditional return in TeacherReviewTab - moved to top of function with other hooks
lessons_v2.py: POST /ai-generate-lesson endpoint correctly validates topic is required (line 778)
lessons_v2.py: AI generation uses Gemini 2.0 Flash model with proper system prompt for TCIS curriculum
MonitoringModule.jsx: TeacherReviewTab now fetches ALL staff without .filter(s => s.role === 'Teacher')
MonitoringModule.jsx: ROLE_COLORS object provides colored badges for all staff roles
MonitoringModule.jsx: staffFilter state and uniqueRoles computed from teachers array for filter dropdown
